title: Predicting cell-binding retention after developability repair

cases.study_information: All molecules are anti-IL-2Rgamma VHHs in the same monovalent VHH-Fc format. Human KD values are the printed Table 23 values against recombinant human IL-2Rbeta-gamma extracellular-domain reagent P1AE2657. These were measured on a Biacore 8K at 25 C, capturing VHH-Fc on an anti-PGLALA CM3 surface, using receptor as analyte and a 1:1 Langmuir fit. The benchmark neutral-pH label is 7.5. No numerical cynomolgus results are printed in this table; those fields remain unavailable. Cell binding was measured on human IL-2Rbeta-gamma Bioassay cells with antibody incubation for 60 min at 4 C and anti-human-Fc PE median-fluorescence detection. The hidden retention endpoint uses all 11 positive observed concentration columns from the published figure, excluding the separately plotted zero-dose control. Concentrations are digitized approximate chart coordinates rather than an asserted exact serial-dilution recipe. Parent, variant and DP47 curves are always matched within the same panel. Ranking is scored only on differences robust to conservative curve-reading and log-dose-coordinate uncertainty; unresolved pairs are not forced into an experimental total order.

output_format: One comma-separated line containing every target exactly once, in the requested order; no explanation.

pairwise_policy.pair_definition: strictly positive paired retention difference under propagated digitization bounds; same-parent/background covariance retained; cross-parent marginal bounds
pairwise_policy.bounds_interpretation: digitization uncertainty only; not biological confidence intervals
pairwise_policy.actual_case_membership: only verified complete curves; never invent to meet expected source count

target_antigen: anti-IL-2Rgamma VHH-Fc; human IL-2Rbeta/gamma-expressing cells; species-matched IL-2Rbeta/gamma ECD for SPR
random_pass_probability_note: Two reliable pairs share a loser; uniform random complete rankings pass with probability 1/3. Threshold 1.0 cannot remove this information limit.
